evidence.title: Libya’s parliament removes Speaker Saleh after 12 years as discontent grows

occurrences.checkable_against: Libya Observer report and House session record
occurrences.quote_span: The vote was overseen by Second Deputy Speaker Misbah Douma, according to the Libya Observer.
occurrences.speaker: Libya Observer
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libyan political leadership and Haftar family position records
occurrences.quote_span: Saleh has long been considered a staunch ally of the Haftar clan, but analysts said he appeared to be weakened as Haftar’s sons, in particular Saddam Haftar, consolidated their positions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libya House of Representatives member biography and committee records
occurrences.quote_span: Al-Obeidi, who comes from the same tribe as Saleh, represents the eastern city of Tobruk and has chaired parliament’s Libyan-Turkish friendship committee.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libya House of Representatives election record for deputy speakers
occurrences.quote_span: The House on Tuesday also elected Tarek al-Ashtar and Mesbah Douma as first and second deputy speakers, respectively.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libyan government and eastern administration records
occurrences.quote_span: The developments come as Libya remains divided politically and militarily between the United Nations-recognised government in Tripoli led by Prime Minister Abdul Hamid Dbeibah, and a rival administration in the east backed by renegade military commander Khalifa Haftar.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Aguila Saleh announcement and House session schedule
occurrences.quote_span: He had also announced that he had cancelled the session he had called for Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: Aguila Saleh
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libya House of Representatives speaker election record
occurrences.quote_span: Libya’s eastern-based House of Representatives has elected a new speaker, ending Aguila Saleh’s 12-year tenure amid growing discontent among lawmakers over his leadership.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. government statements and Massad Boulos appointment or Libya reunification plan documents
occurrences.quote_span: The United States is pursuing a separate reunification plan for the oil and gas-rich North African country, led by Massad Boulos, President Donald Trump’s senior adviser for Arab and African affairs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libya House of Representatives vote record and parliament spokesperson announcement
occurrences.quote_span: Legislators in the 170-member House voted on Tuesday to replace Saleh with Al-Salhin Abdelnabi al-Obeidi, the parliament’s spokesperson announced on X.
occurrences.speaker: Libya House of Representatives spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Libya House of Representatives location and Haftar-controlled territory records
occurrences.quote_span: Haftar’s camp relies in particular on the parliament, which sits in the eastern city of Benghazi under their control.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives

occurrences.checkable_against: Emadeddin Badi statement and Chatham House records
occurrences.quote_span: “Agila Saleh appears to be the latest casualty of Saddam Haftar’s drive to centralise decision-making in eastern Libya and bulldoze his way into a political role,” said Emadeddin Badi, an analyst at the London-based Chatham House.
occurrences.speaker: Emadeddin Badi
occurrences.subject: Libya House of Representatives
